summary: Bound and atomicize API dependency DAG validation

architecture.decision: Read DAG edges and reference existence from SQLiteTicketIndex.dag_snapshot without decoding ticket_json or scanning archived YAML files, serialize validation and unlocked canonical store writes under one store lock, enforce a byte-bounded fallback or typed retryable 503 refusal, and emit explicit X-Planfile-Mutation-Stage diagnostics.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit on main; schema v1 SQLite tables and canonical YAML/sharded files remain unchanged.

nonGoals: Adding a separate dependency source of truth outside canonical ticket records
delivery.outcome: API dependency validation runs boundedly against indexed edge projections inside the canonical write lock with typed retryable unavailability and stage-level diagnostics.

validation.evidence: Verified 0 pf.list_tickets calls and 0 archive YAML reads across 200 archived tickets using SQLiteTicketIndex.dag_snapshot.
Barrier-synchronized opposing edge mutations serialized under one store lock; every round returned [200, 409] with acyclic final DAG.
Missing small index fell back safely to bounded records scan (409 cycle); oversized stale store returned retryable 503 dag_validation_index_unavailable and recovered after repair.
65 API/lock tests + 128 index/findings tests (193 passed), ruff passed, and ./project/governance-check.sh --base origin/main plus wellman check passed.
